tools.name: check_software

tools.name: get_fix_prompt
tools.description: The reviewed fix procedure of one incident for one operating system. Takes an incident id returned by the other Fixlane tools. Desktop systems (macos, windows, linux) get an agent prompt: a read-only check first, then the fix. Phones (ios, android) get manual steps only.

tools.name: latest_incidents
tools.description: The newest incidents Fixlane serves, newest first, optionally for one operating system and since a date (YYYY-MM-DD). At most 20, each with its incident id.

tools.name: get_digest
tools.description: One fix prompt for everything to update now on a desktop system (macos, windows, linux). Returns only a digest that passed lint and review. Phones have no digest.

tools.name: check_inventory
tools.description: Compares installed programs and versions (at most 50 items, version optional) with verified fixed versions.
